name: Paper review panel
description: A pre-submission review panel: five AI reviewers — scientific soundness, an adversarial referee, evidence and claims, references, figures and tables — read the same manuscript in parallel, and a judge consolidates their findings into one ranked list with a recommendation. The AI advises; the researcher decides. The sample paper is fictional and has problems planted in it. Paths are relative to the working directory, so run this from the repository root.
author: AI-Graph
